scope: Five previously reproduced P1 findings only; current working tree after the main agent's fixes.
conclusion: All five reported counterexample classes are fixed for the reviewed source hashes and isolated scenarios. This is not production activation approval or a full-system safety guarantee.

isolation.dotenv: load_dotenv patched before importing a private Core package alias.
isolation.guards: Audit hook active during each fixture rejects file writes, disk SQLite, .env access, service connections and subprocess launches.
isolation.network_exception: Only the exact standard-library socketpair implementation may establish the Windows asyncio internal loopback wakeup pair.

assertion_definition: Counts actual calls to expect(), including a failing assertion and one no-forbidden-IO assertion per completed fixture; excludes unittest's internal assertions. A failing test stops at its first failed behavioral assertion.

findings.issue: Unbound duplicate approval authorizes the next parameters.
findings.observed: Duplicate approval cannot dispatch the second recipient; a fresh explicit second ticket still dispatches it once.

findings.issue: Cancellation received while approval is queued does not prevent dispatch.
findings.observed: Zero executor calls; action retains cancelled status.

findings.issue: MCP same-ID reverse requests or malformed envelopes become success receipts.
findings.observed: Reverse ping plus real tool failure and missing-result envelopes cannot produce accepted-send claims; valid receipt text remains visible.

findings.issue: Reused unknown actions or permission denials permit fabricated completion.
findings.observed: Unknown remains unknown without redispatch; denied write is never dispatched; scripted success text is replaced by the adverse outcome.

findings.issue: Post-tool model errors lose shared-budget accounting and no-pending continuation replenishes work.
findings.observed: Same-task limits survive model failure and continuation/effort changes. Exhausted call or round budgets do not add plain completion calls.

reproduction.python: Existing project-compatible Python 3.12 runtime; use -B -X utf8.
reproduction.baseline_source: Export only services/agent-core/agent_core from baseline_commit using git archive into a newly allocated temporary directory.
reproduction.baseline_selection: Set HARNESS_REVIEW_CORE_ROOT to the exported services/agent-core directory, then execute the exact same current test file.
reproduction.comparison: The same test SHA-256 was used for both final runs; no implementation or baseline test expectations were rewritten.

boundaries: No real model, MCP service, production Core, microphone or filesystem mutation tool was exercised.
No physical file/junction or real delivery semantics validated.
No full-repository review or full regression run performed by this reviewer; the main agent owns those gates.
Passing these isolated tests does not replace user-facing or production activation acceptance.
